name: Brewers jersey, men's L or XL, $60 or less
why: Ben's test case: a Brewers fan after a World Series win wants a jersey that fits him, and wants to hear the moment one is listed under his price. Size L or XL and $60 are the trial's stand-ins for his own size and price. Basketball and soccer-style 'Brewers' giveaway jerseys don't count (agent default; Ben can say otherwise).
